profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. describes itself as a provider of global fiber network, secure networking, edge cloud, and AI-ready infrastructure. The company says its network is the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy, with an expansive fiber footprint that reduces latency for real-time performance. Its website highlights customer deployments such as diverse 100G paths with automatic failover for the New York Yankees, a private low-latency network for American Family Care, and a claim that Prometheus Hyperscale anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while maintaining performance. The site also mentions retail use cases including real-time inventory, AI-driven personalization, and DDoS protection.

Lumen is a for-profit public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, trading under the ticker LUMN and filing with the SEC under CIK 0000018926. Court records list 57 legal matters in Louisiana involving the company. The company does not name individual AI products on its site; it emphasizes AI-ready networking and edge cloud.
